Ardevora Asset Management Llp increased its stake in Skyworks Solutions Inc (SWKS) by 18.39% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ardevora Asset Management Llp who had been investing in Skyworks Solutions Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.14 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.58% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $68.4. About 462,776 shares traded. Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:SWKS) has declined 30.24% since January 17, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.24% the S&P500.
Ardevora Asset Management Llp, which manages about $3.60 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Illumina Inc (NASDAQ:ILMN) by 14,350 shares to 80,262 shares, valued at $29.46M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Church & Dwight Inc (NYSE:CHD) by 119,100 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 608,588 shares, and cut its stake in Becton Dickinson & Co (NYSE:BDX).
